pricing.summary: The page keeps Figma's order (hero, billing toggle, three plan cards, comparison table) but almost every section differs: the hero copy and eyebrow, the card geometry and styling, the toggle control and the whole comparison table are not what Figma draws, and the build adds a FAQ the design does not have. The worst defects are real bugs: the Church card shows '$0 / month' instead of 'Custom', all three plan buttons do nothing, 'MOST POPULAR' and 'Save 20%' do not render as badges, and muted text fails AA.

findings.title: Billing toggle has no accessible name and no group semantics
findings.figma: Figma draws two named options ('Monthly', 'Annual · save 20%') in one pill: reads as a two-option choice.
